when: Prose INSIDE a question — the stem and the answer's explanation.
signals: sits between a question head and the next question head
reads as a sentence, not as an equation
notes: 18.5px. The reference has 516 of these; rendering them as .para sets Part 2 a half-point small throughout. A second phrasing of the same question is `.q.variant-head` — `अथवा (2025 के विकल्प)` — an ordinary question paragraph, not a rule across the column. The marks pill that rides on the question head is `.qmarks` — a yellow-bordered chip, named here so the editor can treat it as the object it looks like rather than as a run of text inside the heading; it was the one thing on a question head that could not be moved or deleted on its own.
